subject: POC trial plan & model selection
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lee <sara.lee@avatech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC trial plan & model selection

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed POC plan so we can get you a working sandbox this week.

Recap / priority needs you mentioned:
- Primary use: customer support triage + multilingual FAQ generation (EN + ES, with some French examples)
- Success criteria: intent classification accuracy >= 88% (macro F1) on your sample set; generation quality judged by internal rubric (no unsafe hallucinations on the 50 test prompts); 95th %-ile latency < 250ms for short-turn queries; cost target ~ $0.50 / 1k tokens (ballpark)
- Data constraints: no PHI, PII redaction required in logs; prefer sandbox in us-east region

Proposed POC (2-week sandbox):
1) Scope
   - Ingest 2k of your anonymized support transcripts + 200 canonical prompts you provided.
   - Run evaluation harness (we'll use the attached eval-metrics.csv) and a small human review set.
2) Model candidates for trial
   - Primary: Llama-3 13B (quantized 8-bit, Redwood-verified profile) — good tradeoff for latency/cost and supports fine-tuning/adapter flows.
   - Fallback variant: Mistral 7B Instruct (lower-cost option, slightly smaller context handling) — good for bursty traffic or budget-constrained mode.
   - Multilingual handling: Llama-3 13B shows reasonable Spanish throughput; for French edge-cases we can test backoff to Llama-2 70B if you want higher-quality cross-lingual capability (adds cost).
3) Success criteria & evaluation
   - Automated eval: intent accuracy, F1, response BLEU/ROUGE against canonical answers, latency distribution.
   - Manual eval: 50-random human-labeled prompts across EN/ES/FR for hallucination and safety checks.
   - Pass threshold: >=88% intent F1, manual quality score >= 4/5, no high-severity hallucinations in manual set.
4) Timeline (target)
   - Mon (Day 0): sign sandbox terms + share anonymized transcripts
   - Day 1-2: infra & IAM access (sandbox environment setup)
   - Day 3-6: ingest + run baseline evaluations on candidate models
   - Day 7-10: tune prompts / caching / batching config; run manual evals
   - Day 11-14: present results, recommend model + rollout plan
5) Owners
   - Redwood SE lead: Laura Bennett (implementation + infra)
   - Redwood eval owner: Marissa Cole (metric design + reporting)
   - Avatech POC lead: Sara Lee (data access + business signoff)

Next steps I suggest: please confirm the success criteria above and whether 2 weeks aligns with your timelines. Also confirm you can share the anonymized transcripts via the secure link (we can provide a presigned S3) and whether you want us to enable the Mistral fallback or test Llama-2 70B for French.

Attachments: Redwood-POC-plan-template.pdf (template POC SOW), eval-metrics.csv (example metrics)

Thanks — I can set up the sandbox as soon as we have a quick confirmation.

Best,
Ben

Ben —

Thanks for the detailed plan and templates, this is very helpful. High level: we agree to the 2-week sandbox approach and the success criteria you outlined look reasonable. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Timeline - can we push the kickoff to Monday next week? Our data team needs 2 business days to anonymize transcripts.
2) Multilingual - Spanish is priority after English; French is lower priority but we would like you to run a quick comparison in the POC if it’s low overhead. If Llama-3 struggles on French we can evaluate the Llama-2 70B fallback.
3) Sandbox access - we prefer a dedicated isolated sandbox (no shared tenant) with password-protected access; is that possible for a 2-week trial?
4) Security / compliance - we need a one-page summary of logging/retention settings and whether you can redact PII before logs hit Redwood. Also: SOC2 attestation and any required access controls.

Ownership: I will be the Avatech POC lead (Sara Lee). Please loop in Procurement if there are any billing/terms to sign — we typically use a short SOW for trials.

If you can send an updated timeline that pushes kickoff to Monday (Day 0 = next Monday), I’ll get the data team started on anonymization today.

Thanks,
Sara
